description: MENA - Energy Indicators is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Economics and prices, Extractive industries", published or maintained by Haroun Beltaifa (World Bank Group). Various indicators for MENA countries to get an overview of the countries energy and economic profiles. The indicators are organized in 6 categories: economic indicators, energy indicators, oil indicators, gas indicators, electricity indicators & energy efficiency indicators. Each indicator includes name, unit, yearand value for that year. Format included are Excel spreasheet, CSV & JSON. Coverage: 17 countries in the Middle East and North Africa. It has 3 files in XLS, CSV, JSON. The portal files it under Economics and prices, Extractive industries, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
